result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The one clear visual defect is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section, whose hero image failed to load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. No other layout, alignment, or content defects are evident.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a grey box with a broken-image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant photo, while all other cards show real imagery. This looks broken and makes the featured card visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this restaurant, and add a graceful fallback (e.g., branded placeholder or cuisine illustration) so a failed image load never exposes the raw broken-image icon.
